decision.outcome: The study failed as declared: no repaired rollout passed the scorer, so no repair pair was found.

findings.training_failures: 2112 sampled training rollouts, 1922 passed. Of the 190 failures, 178 are compositional cases (mostly wrong drafts in the latest and scope corrections and in date first rounds); 5 are growth cases.
findings.located: Only 9 failures started a date shift from an unjustified base. In every one, the module had already read a different revision than the goal source and computed the total from it, so repairing the shift alone could not pass.
findings.interpretation: The development error, applying the review interval twice, does not appear on training cases; it arises with the held-out added-day correction, so training-case repairs carry no signal for it.
